title: The equivalence point
caption: At equivalence the acid and base have reacted in exactly the amounts in the equation. For 25.0 cm³ of 0.100 mol dm⁻³ HCl that is 2.50 × 10⁻³ mol, so 25.0 cm³ of 0.100 mol dm⁻³ NaOH; the pH there is 7 and the curve is steepest.
alt: Strong acid–strong base titration curve with the equivalence point marked at 25.0 cm³ and pH 7.
description: Before equivalence: pH rises slowly from 1.
At 25.0 cm³: an almost vertical jump through pH 7.
After: excess alkali, pH levels near 12.5.
